bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is week-to-week with a right hamstring injury he sustained midway through the fourth quarter of Sunday's 9-3 loss to the Vikings at Soldier Field. However, Williams has avoided a significant injury, and even if he sits out in Week 3, that's likely all the time he will miss , with Tyson Bagent ready to step in if needed.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are dealing with a struggling defense after a 41-31 Week 2 loss to the Buffalo Bills, with safety Avonte Maddox now out for the year, prompting the team to promise shake-ups in the secondary . In response, head coach Dan Campbell and the front office may have to consider looking at the trade market to address the injury woes , while the team has also re-signed veteran safety Jalen Mills to their practice squad to add depth.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are dealing with the fallout from their overtime win over the New York Jets, most notably wide receiver Jayden Reed suffering a neck injury that will keep him overnight in New York . Meanwhile, the team has already turned its focus to Week 3, releasing its Packers-Falcons injury report on Sept.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Quarterback Kyler Murray has cleared concussion protocol and is back in the starting lineup for the Minnesota Vikings , with head coach Kevin O'Connell confirming Murray will start Sunday when the undefeated Vikings (2-0) visit Tampa Bay to face Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers (0-2) . This is a major boost for Minnesota after Murray was knocked out of the Week 1 win over Green Bay, and it comes on the heels of the Vikings' gritty 9-3 road victory over the Chicago Bears in Week 2.
